data.name: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited
data.description: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited (the 'Company') is a public company limited by shares incorporated in Pakistan on June 17, 1963 under the repealed Companies Act, 1913 (now, the Companies Act, 2017) and its shares are quoted on Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited. The principal activity of the Company is the purchase, transmission, distribution and supply of natural gas.
